verdict.rationale: Skyvern's first-party docs explicitly describe saving signed-in state as reusable browser profiles: "Use a profile when you want to sign in once and reuse that later" and "save signed-in state as reusable browser profiles". Sessions persist cookies and local storage, so later runs can skip the login wall; stored credentials let every agent reuse a saved login. missing for 10: detailed docs on the profile API/lifecycle (creating, attaching and expiring profiles across runs), independent or hands-on corroboration that profiles reliably bypass logins.
